<?php
/**
 * KerberosAuthenticatedDatabaseDriver.php
 * Handles cross-service authentication via Kerberos constrained delegation
 * for database connections in a multi-tier application.
 */

namespace App\Database\Auth;

use App\Security\TicketCache;
use App\Security\KerberosContext;

class KerberosAuthenticatedDatabaseDriver
{
    private string $servicePrincipal;
    private string $keytabPath;
    private array $allowedDelegationTargets;
    private TicketCache $ticketCache;
    private KerberosContext $krbContext;
    private bool $constrainedDelegation;
    private array $protocolTransitionConfig;

    public function __construct(array $config)
    {
        $this->servicePrincipal = $config['service_principal'];
        $this->keytabPath = $config['keytab_path'];
        $this->allowedDelegationTargets = $config['allowed_targets'] ?? [];
        $this->ticketCache = new TicketCache($config['cache_dir']);
        $this->krbContext = new KerberosContext();
        $this->constrainedDelegation = $config['constrained_delegation'] ?? true;
        $this->protocolTransitionConfig = $config['protocol_transition'] ?? [];
    }

    /**
     * Authenticate to the database service using S4U2Proxy (constrained delegation)
     * This allows the application service to request tickets on behalf of users.
     */
    public function connectAsUser(string $userPrincipal, string $dbServiceTarget): \PDO
    {
        // Step 1: Validate the target is in our allowed delegation list
        $this->validateDelegationTarget($dbServiceTarget);

        // Step 2: Obtain S4U2Self ticket (protocol transition)
        $s4u2selfTicket = $this->obtainS4U2SelfTicket($userPrincipal);

        // Step 3: Use S4U2Proxy to get a service ticket for the DB
        $serviceTicket = $this->obtainS4U2ProxyTicket($s4u2selfTicket, $dbServiceTarget);

        // Step 4: Connect using the delegated credential
        return $this->establishConnection($serviceTicket, $dbServiceTarget);
    }

    private function validateDelegationTarget(string $target): void
    {
        if ($this->constrainedDelegation) {
            $targetService = $this->extractServiceComponent($target);
            $isAllowed = false;
            foreach ($this->allowedDelegationTargets as $allowed) {
                if ($this->matchesDelegationTarget($targetService, $allowed)) {
                    $isAllowed = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!$isAllowed) {
                throw new \RuntimeException(
                    "Delegation to target '{$target}' is not permitted by constrained delegation policy"
                );
            }
        }
    }

    private function extractServiceComponent(string $spn): string
    {
        // SPN format: service/hostname@REALM
        $parts = explode('/', $spn, 2);
        return $parts[0] ?? '';
    }

    private function matchesDelegationTarget(string $targetService, string $allowedPattern): bool
    {
        // Normalize for comparison
        return strcasecmp($targetService, $allowedPattern) === 0;
    }

    /**
     * S4U2Self: Obtain a ticket to ourselves on behalf of the user.
     * This implements protocol transition (S4U2Self) per MS-SFU.
     */
    private function obtainS4U2SelfTicket(string $userPrincipal): array
    {
        $this->krbContext->initFromKeytab($this->keytabPath, $this->servicePrincipal);

        // Check if protocol transition is enabled and user is eligible
        if (!$this->isProtocolTransitionAllowed($userPrincipal)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException(
                "Protocol transition not allowed for principal: {$userPrincipal}"
            );
        }

        $ticket = $this->krbContext->s4u2self($userPrincipal, $this->servicePrincipal);

        if (!$ticket || !isset($ticket['enc_part'])) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Failed to obtain S4U2Self ticket');
        }

        return $ticket;
    }

    /**
     * S4U2Proxy: Use the S4U2Self ticket to request a ticket to the target service.
     */
    private function obtainS4U2ProxyTicket(array $evidenceTicket, string $targetSPN): array
    {
        // The forwardable flag check is critical for constrained delegation security
        $ticketFlags = $evidenceTicket['flags'] ?? 0;
        $forwardableFlag = 0x40000000;

        // Per MS-SFU 3.2.5.2.2: If the service is configured for constrained
        // delegation, the KDC checks the FORWARDABLE flag in the evidence ticket.
        // However, with Resource-Based Constrained Delegation (RBCD), this check
        // is performed differently.
        if ($this->isResourceBasedDelegation($targetSPN)) {
            // RBCD path: the target service's msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity
            // attribute controls access. Forwardable flag is NOT required.
            $serviceTicket = $this->krbContext->s4u2proxy(
                $evidenceTicket,
                $targetSPN,
                ['bypass_forwardable_check' => true]
            );
        } else {
            // Traditional constrained delegation: FORWARDABLE flag IS required
            if (!($ticketFlags & $forwardableFlag)) {
                throw new \RuntimeException(
                    'Evidence ticket is not forwardable; cannot perform S4U2Proxy'
                );
            }
            $serviceTicket = $this->krbContext->s4u2proxy($evidenceTicket, $targetSPN);
        }

        $this->ticketCache->store($targetSPN, $serviceTicket);
        return $serviceTicket;
    }

    /**
     * Determine if the target uses Resource-Based Constrained Delegation.
     * RBCD allows the TARGET to specify who can delegate to it, rather than
     * the source being configured with allowed targets.
     */
    private function isResourceBasedDelegation(string $targetSPN): bool
    {
        // Check if the target SPN's service account has
        // msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity configured
        $targetAccount = $this->krbContext->resolveServiceAccount($targetSPN);
        $rbcdAttribute = $this->krbContext->getLdapAttribute(
            $targetAccount,
            'msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity'
        );

        if ($rbcdAttribute !== null) {
            // Verify our service is in the allowed list
            $allowedPrincipals = $this->parseSecurityDescriptor($rbcdAttribute);
            return in_array($this->servicePrincipal, $allowedPrincipals, true);
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function isProtocolTransitionAllowed(string $userPrincipal): bool
    {
        // Check TrustedToAuthForDelegation (T2A4D) flag on our service account
        $t2a4d = $this->protocolTransitionConfig['trusted_to_auth'] ?? false;
        if (!$t2a4d) {
            return false;
        }

        // Validate user exists in the realm
        $realm = $this->extractRealm($userPrincipal);
        if ($realm && $realm !== $this->extractRealm($this->servicePrincipal)) {
            // Cross-realm protocol transition requires additional trust validation
            return $this->validateCrossRealmTrust($realm);
        }

        return true;
    }

    private function extractRealm(string $principal): string
    {
        $parts = explode('@', $principal);
        return $parts[1] ?? '';
    }

    private function validateCrossRealmTrust(string $realm): bool
    {
        $trustedRealms = $this->protocolTransitionConfig['trusted_realms'] ?? [];
        return in_array($realm, $trustedRealms, true);
    }

    private function parseSecurityDescriptor(string $descriptor): array
    {
        // Parse the binary security descriptor to extract allowed principals
        return $this->krbContext->parseSD($descriptor);
    }

    private function establishConnection(array $serviceTicket, string $targetSPN): \PDO
    {
        $hostname = $this->extractHostFromSPN($targetSPN);
        $dsn = "pgsql:host={$hostname};dbname=appdb;sslmode=require";

        // Use GSSAPI authentication with the obtained service ticket
        $this->krbContext->injectTicketToCache($serviceTicket);

        $pdo = new \PDO($dsn, '', '', [
            \PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => \PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
        ]);

        return $pdo;
    }

    private function extractHostFromSPN(string $spn): string
    {
        // SPN format: service/hostname@REALM
        $withoutRealm = explode('@', $spn)[0];
        $parts = explode('/', $withoutRealm, 2);
        return $parts[1] ?? '';
    }
}
